Class UIEffects

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.mesos.view.GUI.Controllers.UIEffects
public class UIEffects extends Object
Utility class providing reusable JavaFX visual effects for UI components. All methods are static since this class holds no state.

    • applyBackground

      public static void applyBackground(javafx.scene.layout.AnchorPane rootPane)
      Loads and applies the standard Mesos background image to the given AnchorPane. The image is bound to the pane's width and height so it scales with the window.
      Parameters:
      rootPane - the AnchorPane to apply the background to

    • applyClickEffect

      public static void applyClickEffect(javafx.scene.control.Button button)
      Applies a subtle scale-down click effect to a button. The button shrinks slightly on press and returns to normal on release, giving tactile feedback to the user.
      Parameters:
      button - the button to apply the effect to

    • applyCardClickEffect

      public static void applyCardClickEffect(CardController card, String cardId)
      Applies a click visual effect to a card slot based on the card type. Event cards show a red glow and reduced opacity to signal they are not playable. Character cards show a lime glow with a slight scale down. Building cards show an orange glow with a slight scale down.
      Parameters:
      card - the CardController to apply the effect to
      cardId - the id of the card, used to determine its type from the prefix

    • applyCardHoverEffect

      public static void applyCardHoverEffect(CardController card, String cardId)
      Applies a hover visual effect to a card slot based on the card type. Event cards show a dark red glow with a not-allowed cursor to signal they are not playable. All other card types show a yellow glow with a hand cursor.
      Parameters:
      card - the CardController to apply the effect to
      cardId - the id of the card, used to determine its type from the prefix

    • applyCardExitEffect

      public static void applyCardExitEffect(CardController card)
      Removes any active visual effect from a card slot, restoring its default appearance.
      Parameters:
      card - the CardController to reset the effect on
